messages:
maria: Heads-up: PR #4861 contains migration notes for Private -> Dedicated routing, plus JS/TS SDK snippets. Preview flagged a couple of link lints and a voice inconsistency. Need eyes on terminology and the SDK examples before merge.
ana: @maria I'll review the tone/tense today. Quick ask: are we using "Redwood Private" as the formal product name everywhere? I saw "private deployment" and plain "private" in the doc.
kevin: I can check the code snippets for up-to-date SDK usage. Which languages?
josh: JS + TS + short streaming example would be helpful. Also ensure examples don't include an API key literal.
lina: I ran the preview locally; link-checker shows 3 broken links (one to /docs/sdk/js/v2, one to an internal anchor, one to the legacy migration doc). Also markdown linter complains about fenced code block language tags missing.
docs-bot: Docs preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4861 - Link-check: 3 broken links, 2 warnings.
kevin: For JS we should use: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'Hello' });
```
kevin: Note: prefer `apiKey` env var pattern, and avoid `region: 'us-east-1'` in snippets.
maria: Thanks. I'll replace hard-coded keys and region. On terminology, let's standardize to `Redwood Private` (product name) and use second-person voice for procedural steps.
nana: Tiny style rules: 1) use active voice, 2) use present tense, 3) use second person for steps ("You can"), 4) inline-code for API identifiers (``redwood.Client`` / ``redwood.Chat.create``).
lina: I'll fix the anchor and point the broken SDK link to /docs/sdk/js (v2 note inside the page). Also adding fenced language markers for all code blocks.
josh: One more nit: examples should show a short streaming snippet or link to streaming guide, but keep it collapsible in the page to avoid noise. Something like: ```js
// streaming (pseudo)
const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'Hi' });
for await (const chunk of stream) console.log(chunk.text);
```
kevin: LGTM for the snippet. Also suggest including a quick compatibility note if users are migrating from older client versions.
docs-bot: CI Link Check output:
ERROR: Broken link: /docs/sdk/js/v2 -> 404
ERROR: Broken link: /docs/private/legacy-migration -> 404
ERROR: Broken link: #streaming-section -> 404
WARNING: fenced-code-language: docs/private/migration.md:45
WARNING: line-length: docs/private/migration.md:120

maria: I'm going to push a patch: change links to /docs/sdk/js, add a redirect for legacy-migration, add the streaming anchor, and mark code blocks with languages. Will also run style-checker to clean passive voice instances.
nana: If you want, I can run a quick pass after your push to confirm voice/tense.
maria: Pushed. New preview should be up.
docs-bot: New preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/4861/2 - Link-check: 0 broken links, 0 warnings.
josh: Approved from my side. Added comment suggesting the collapsible streaming example + link to streaming guide.
kevin: Approved the SDK snippets.
lina: Quick follow-up: please add a one-line changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md mentioning migration notes and SDK snippet updates.
maria: Added changelog line and tag `ready/merge`. Scheduling merge during the docs merge window tomorrow 09:00 UTC to avoid CI peak.
nana: Approved and added :thumbsup: reaction.
kevin: Thanks everyone. Smooth fast turnaround.
maria: Merged in the morning window. :party:
